_doc: Which of dayflow's intake lanes take their work from the brain's list (docs/design/brain_delegates_work_2026-10-04.md, section 5: cut over one lane at a time, behind a switch). mode: off (the steward handles the lane, as before), dry_run (the list-item intake node logs what it would do and does nothing), live (work is made from the list, and the lane stops reaching the steward). calendar.from_day: the first day (local, the day boundary's date) whose calendar is the brain's; earlier days stay the steward's. concern.since: UTC ISO time from which concern entries are the brain's to delegate; entries made before stay as they are. Read on every planning tick and brain pass.
